correctness.rationale: The Mallows q^inv insertion-rank factorization gives independent U_t with P(U_t=r)=q^(t-r)/[t]_q, for every n>=2 and real q>0. Record R_t=1{U_t=t}, descent D_i=1{U_{i+1}<=U_i}; hence cross-covariance is zero for j outside {i,i+1}. Conditioning on record i gives the positive diagonal ([i+1]_q-1-q)/((1+q)[i]_q[i+1]_q); record i+1 forces D_i=0, giving negative superdiagonal -q/((1+q)[i+1]_q). Sum per i simplifies to -q/((1+q)[i]_q[i+1]_q), strictly negative; q=1 telescopes to -(n-1)/(2n). Independently enumerated all exact rational covariance entries for n=2..6 and q=1/2,1,2, all matched. This is an all-finite-n identity by factorization, not finite extrapolation.
residual_risks: Covariance-zero outside adjacent positions does not imply independence or negative association.
Finite enumerations corroborate exact rational algebra only.
